description: Specificity control for ATOSA-DDX47 tissue co-expression against a 130-gene background panel
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

def gencode(sym):
    g=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene",params={"geneId":sym,"page":0,"itemsPerPage":20},timeout=60).json()
    h=[d for d in g.get("data",[]) if d.get("geneSymbol","").upper()==sym.upper()]
    return h[0]["gencodeId"] if h else None

# control panel: all human DEAD/DEAH-box genes + a broad random background set
ddx=["DDX1","DDX3X","DDX5","DDX6","DDX10","DDX17","DDX18","DDX19B","DDX20","DDX21","DDX23","DDX24","DDX27",
     "DDX28","DDX31","DDX39B","DDX41","DDX42","DDX46","DDX47","DDX49","DDX50","DDX52","DDX54","DDX55","DDX56",
     "DDX59","EIF4A1","EIF4A2","EIF4A3","DHX9","DHX15","DHX16","DHX30","DHX36","DHX38"]
bg=["GAPDH","ACTB","TUBB","RPL13A","PGK1","B2M","HPRT1","TBP","SDHA","YWHAZ","UBC","PPIA","POLR2A","EEF1A1",
    "MYC","TP53","CDK1","CCNB1","MKI67","EGFR","VIM","CDH1","COL1A1","FN1","ALB","INS","GCG","MB","MYH7","NEFL",
    "GFAP","SNAP25","SYP","CD4","CD8A","PTPRC","ITGAM","LYZ","HBB","SPI1","GATA1","RUNX1","SOX2","POU5F1","NANOG",
    "FOXP3","IL6","TNF","IFNG","STAT3","NFKB1","JUN","FOS","ATF4","XBP1","HSPA5","CANX","CALR","LAMP1","CTSB",
    "MTOR","AKT1","PTEN","RB1","E2F1","CCND1","BAX","BCL2","CASP3","PARP1","BRCA1","ATM","MSH2","MLH1","PCNA",
    "RRM2","TYMS","TK1","NDUFA1","SDHB","UQCRC1","COX5A","ATP5F1A","CS","IDH1","FH","MDH2","PKM","LDHA","HK1",
    "SLC2A1","INSR","IRS1","PPARG","SREBF1","FASN","ACACA","CPT1A","LPL","APOE","LDLR","HMGCR","SQLE"]
syms=["FAM214A","FAM214B"]+ddx+bg
ids={}
for s in syms:
    g=gencode(s)
    if g: ids[s]=g
print("resolved",len(ids),"of",len(syms))

def med(gid):
    r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
                   params={"gencodeId":gid,"datasetId":"gtex_v8","page":0,"itemsPerPage":100},timeout=120).json()
    d=pd.DataFrame(r["data"])
    return d.set_index("tissueSiteDetailId")["median"] if len(d) else None

cols={}
for s,g in ids.items():
    v=med(g)
    if v is not None and len(v)>40: cols[s]=v
X=pd.DataFrame(cols).dropna()
X=X.rename(columns={"FAM214A":"ATOSA","FAM214B":"ATOSB"})
print("expression matrix:",X.shape)
LX=np.log2(X+1)
r_atosa=LX.corr(method="pearson")["ATOSA"].drop("ATOSA").sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nTop 15 tissue co-expression partners of ATOSA among the 130-gene panel:")
print(r_atosa.head(15).round(3).to_string())
r47=r_atosa["DDX47"]
pct=100*(r_atosa<r47).mean()
ddx_in=[g for g in r_atosa.index if g in ddx]
print(f"\nATOSA vs DDX47 r={r47:.3f}; percentile within 130-gene panel = {pct:.1f}%")
print(f"rank of DDX47 among {len(ddx_in)} DEAD/DEAH-box genes: {1+list(r_atosa[ddx_in].sort_values(ascending=False).index).index('DDX47')}")
print("panel r distribution: median %.3f, 90th pct %.3f, max %.3f"%(r_atosa.median(),r_atosa.quantile(.9),r_atosa.max()))
print("\nDDX47 median TPM range across tissues: %.2f - %.2f (mean %.2f)"%(X.DDX47.min(),X.DDX47.max(),X.DDX47.mean()))
print("compare DDX49 %.1f-%.1f, ATOSA %.1f-%.1f"%(X.DDX49.min(),X.DDX49.max(),X.ATOSA.min(),X.ATOSA.max()))
X.to_csv("/tmp/gtex_panel.csv"); r_atosa.to_csv("/tmp/r_atosa.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax[0].hist(r_atosa.values,bins=28,color="#95a5a6",edgecolor="white")
ax[0].axvline(r47,color="#c0392b",lw=2)
ax[0].annotate(f"DDX47 r={r47:.2f}\n({pct:.0f}th pct)",xy=(r47,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.75),xytext=(r47-0.75,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.85),
               color="#c0392b",arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b"),fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("Pearson r with ATOSA (log2 median TPM, 54 GTEx tissues)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("genes")
ax[0].set_title("ATOSA-DDX47 tissue correlation vs a 130-gene panel",fontsize=10)
ax[1].scatter(LX.ATOSA,LX.DDX47,s=22,color="#2980b9")
ax[1].set_xlabel("ATOSA log2(median TPM+1)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("DDX47 log2(median TPM+1)")
ax[1].set_title(f"ATOSA vs DDX47 across 54 tissues (r={r47:.2f})\nnote DDX47 median TPM is 0.0-2.0, near the quantification floor",fontsize=10)
for a_ in ax: a_.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
